acceptance_signals: A matching human-admitted task and create-only task-start baseline exist before implementation writes.
One immutable UTF-8 source is encoded once and bound by exact byte length and SHA-256 for both dry and actual worker requests.
The parent launches a fixed repository module with an argument vector and JSON stdin; it never transports replay source as multiline python -c text.
The worker validates the protocol, digest and length, compiles the source, resolves source-owned imports during isolated execution, and exposes only a fixed dry or actual mode global.
The worker and parent suppress raw source output, stderr, traceback, host paths, environment, credentials and process details, returning only bounded status, phase and reason-code facts.
Actual mode is attempted exactly once only after dry mode passes; any first deviation stops with no retry and zero actual attempts when dry fails.

Fixture tests cover dry and actual success, syntax failure, import failure, initialization or execution failure, malformed protocol, transport failure or timeout, source identity mismatch, raw-output suppression, and no-retry gating.
All tests use harmless local fixture sources and mocks and never invoke the real artifact caller, readiness probe, replay driver, action, build, cleanup, network, or evidence writer.

Existing dirty-worktree content outside the exact included paths remains byte-identical; existing baselines and pre-task shared-document content are preservation-only except for the new baseline and bounded additions.
Focused tests, full supported tests, task and repository governance checks, task-start scope validation, JSON parsing and git diff checks pass.
No real artifact replay, dependency installation, external Agent or model, Git mutation, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or broader journey occurs.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-54cf500a0d5c4d7d80921bf306f111f2 and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Add one dependency-free repository-internal two-phase artifact replay harness that transports one UTF-8 source through a fixed Python module worker over bounded JSON stdin, compiles and executes the same digest-bound source first in dry mode and only then in actual mode, resolves source-owned imports inside the worker, and converts worker, compilation, import, initialization, execution, timeout, and protocol failures into stable privacy-bounded reason codes. The implementation and fixture tests must not call the real artifact caller, readiness probe, replay driver, action, build, cleanup, or network.

items: A child can emit arbitrary bytes at the OS descriptor level; the parent must never surface captured raw output and must fail closed on non-protocol output.
A child may hang; the parent must enforce one bounded timeout and must not retry.
Shared documentation files already contain user work; only bounded append or contract additions may be made.
Broad baseline-prefix inclusion is preservation-only for every pre-existing baseline.
This harness reduces transport failure risk but does not authorize or prove a real replay.
Reviewed assumption: Python 3.11 or newer stdlib subprocess, json, base64, hashlib and compile behavior is available.
Reviewed assumption: A fixed module worker invoked from the repository root is a portable replacement for the failed multiline python -c boundary.
Reviewed assumption: Source-owned imports can be exercised through fixture modules without executing any real artifact capability.
Reviewed assumption: The existing co-located scripts test convention remains appropriate for this internal harness.
Reviewed unknown: Whether all supported Windows launcher variants preserve JSON stdin and module arguments identically.
Reviewed unknown: Whether a future real replay source needs an additional bounded result channel beyond process success.
Reviewed unknown: Cross-platform behavior, adversarial child behavior, adoption impact, time savings and causal product benefit remain unproven.

title: Bounded artifact replay harness v1
